content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Brand owner selling packaged shelf-stable foods to grocers; it does not operate stores or sell to households."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Beverage bottler and route distributor selling to retailers; no supermarket operation or pharmacy."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Drive-thru coffee shops selling drinks to individuals; a quick-service restaurant model, not a grocery store."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Propane distributor and appliance service provider; fuel delivery to homes, not supermarkets or pharmacies."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Seafood restaurants, franchising and liquor stores in South Florida; restaurant-led, not a supermarket operator."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"B2B online marketplace for large-item furniture and home goods sold to resellers, not consumer grocery retail."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Meat processor and packaged food manufacturer selling branded products to retailers; it does not run stores."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Operates supermarkets with in-store pharmacy, fuel centers and online pickup selling groceries to households, matching Weis's model."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Hot dog brand licensing and restaurant franchising; brand owner rather than a supermarket retailer."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Apparel and lifestyle brand designer selling mainly wholesale; restaurants are minor and it sells no groceries."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Canned and frozen vegetable processor selling to grocers and distributors; a manufacturer, not a retailer."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Propane and heating oil distributor delivering fuel by truck to homes and businesses; no stores or groceries."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Uniform rental and laundering for businesses on route service; business-to-business service with no retail or grocery overlap."}]}
